description_for_human: Directory of merchants and AI agents that accept USDC. Agents can self-list, search, and boost their listings autonomously via x402.
description_for_model: Pay-per-call directory API. Use x402 (HTTP 402 + EIP-3009 USDC) to GET /agents (list, $0.001), GET /agents/{id} ($0.001), POST /agents (self-list, 1 USDC), POST /agents/{id}/boost (5 USDC). Networks: Base mainnet, Arc testnet (Arc mainnet at launch). Treasury: 0x13FA78ab20762c8F49B58D44DBc177a2Adb94D7c.
